notes.title: 6.6 Update
notes.content:
[Battle]
 Flag capture has been replaced with a system of points of interest.
 Key difference of points of interest:
 Several types of capture points — neutral, enemy, and allied.
 Control over them can be contested.

[Maps]
 Three previously disabled maps have been redesigned and are being returned to the game.

[Battle]
 Battle end rules have been changed.
 Now the battle continues as long as players have tanks in their combat squad or until the timer runs out.
 Previously, the battle ended when the last player on a team lost their tank.

[Battle]
 Added the ability to customize the position of elements in the battle interface.
 You can now configure visible control elements to suit your preferences.

[Battle]
 Tank destruction now includes a new explosion effect with turret detachment in certain situations.

[Battle]
 The matchmaking system has been updated.
 It now primarily uses the combat power of the tank squad.
 Attention — the system will continue to be adjusted during live operation.

[Content]
 Preparation for the transition to Seasons, new vehicles and cosmetics.
 We are moving from the old system — a separate Battle Pass each month — to a large three-month Season, within which new Chapters with rewards will be added each month.

[Content]
 New reward system — Crates.
 Try your luck: open new Crates that may contain new vehicles and Season progress.

[Hangar]
 All quest tasks have been moved to a unified tab.

[Hangar]
 Changes in the tech tree.
 Improved vehicle preview.
 Additionally, you can now upgrade and equip a tank directly from the tech tree without assigning it to a combat squad slot.

[Content]
 Visual improvements to several Premium tanks.

[Hangar]
 Changes in the tech tree.
 Tanks can no longer be sold. A large collection will be required for mechanics to be introduced in future updates.

[Hangar]
 Changes to the battle entry interface.
 Now while waiting for battle you can inspect your tank, read tips, and chat.

[Bugs]
* Fixed incorrect behavior of the “Negative effect duration reduction” parameter
* Fixed visual bugs in offer display
* Fixed issues with Clan Buffs
* Fixed a bug where launching the game paused background music apps
* Numerous other bug fixes

notes.title: Update 6.5.2
notes.content:
Greetings, dear players!
We are excited to present Update 6.5.2!

Let’s go over the key changes with some brief explanations!

- Preparation for the introduction of Battle Slots
In short, you will soon be able to manage a limited combat squad and send it into battle.
However, this feature won’t be available immediately: on March 24, we will perform a necessary server update, with the first rollout on Singapore servers. If the launch goes smoothly, Europe servers will receive Battle Slots a few days later.

- Game optimization for mobile devices
These optimizations have also improved PC performance, especially for players using settings below ULTRA.
According to our internal tests, the game now runs significantly smoother!

- Redesigned 5 battle maps
Old maps, new experience!
We have updated five battle maps, making their gameplay more engaging. Some maps are temporarily unavailable for further improvements.

- Introduction of the "Power" system for vehicles and combat units
Power is a calculated rating that represents a vehicle’s overall combat strength based on its characteristics.
For now, it serves as a reference for comparing different vehicles, but in the future, it will play a greater role in game mechanics.

- Battle difficulty rating introduced
Harder battles will now offer additional rewards.
This change will take effect after the March 24 server update.
The goal is to encourage players to engage in challenging battles instead of leaving matches in search of easier bot opponents.

- Improved equipment purchase reminder
Now more informative and less intrusive.

- Updated vehicle destruction visuals
Added a more cinematic camera effect and expanded enemy information. In future updates, we will enhance explosion effects as well.

- Improved hangar camera behavior
We have added inertia to make tank inspection feel smoother and more comfortable.

- New loading screen design
A fresh look for when you enter the game!

- Various technical fixes
We have made a significant number of technical improvements.

A special thank you to all players who participated in the Beta testing of this update! Your feedback helped us refine and improve the final release.

See you in future updates! 🚀

notes.title: Tank Force 5.0.X Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30478993/b28a98d045efa1a50706c341c1ef0c1efafd5f93.png

Welcome the Halloween season in Tank Force!

Dear tankers, welcome to our Halloween update! Today, we proudly present to you an extensive list of changes and improvements that await you in the world of tank battles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30478993/d5b20798bfe065ee42aede275219002afaeb6939.png


Battle Pass: We've introduced the 'Battle Pass' system - a new seasonal feature that will give you the opportunity to complete exciting missions and earn well-deserved rewards, including the new currency called 'Battle Tokens.' You can exchange these tokens for unique decorations for your tank. The 'Battle Pass' is available in two variants: Standard and Premium.
Tank Decorations: We are revamping the tank decoration system. Now, we have a dedicated section for visual enhancements for your tank, such as decals, camouflages, flags, and attachments. An important change is that visual enhancements will no longer have a limited duration, and we have also revised the combat bonuses for all tank decorations.
New Visual Decorations: We are excited to introduce two new types of visual decorations - flags and attachments. They will provide you with the opportunity to make your tank even more unique!
Offensive and Defensive Bonuses: We have introduced a new type of equipment - offensive and defensive bonuses. Now, you can choose bonuses from different power levels, one offensive and one defensive, to enhance your gameplay strategy.
Game Mode Selection: We have great news for you. Now, you can choose your game mode before hitting the 'Battle' button, making your gaming experience even more convenient.
Improved Graphics: One of the most significant changes is the transition to a new graphical display. You will appreciate the higher quality and modern visual style of the game, made possible by the transition to a new graphics engine. Note: these changes are not final and will be further refined in future updates.
Loading Tip: Now, when you enter the game, you will see an information bar about the game loading process, making your interaction with the game more informative.
New Production Bonuses: We have introduced new bonuses, including seasonal and novice bonuses. Seasonal bonuses will be available only during specific events, which we will tell you more about later.
Improved Tank Acquisition: Now, when purchasing a tank, you will receive an additional ammunition kit and a universal repair kit. You can now head into battle immediately after acquiring your new combat vehicle!
Bug Fixes: And of course, changes have been made to address the issues that our beta testers reported! We thank them and acknowledge their hard work. Thanks to their feedback, we were able to make the game even better.


ATTENTION! The full functionality of the update will be available on October 30th.

We express special thanks to the players who participated in the beta testing of the early version of the application! We love you ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Closed Beta Tests affect on release!
notes.content:
Little news about the release date.

Hello, dear friends!

We will be fair with you:

Did we plan to release the game on 20 of September?
Yes, we did.

Will we do it?
Looks like, unfortunately, we won't. Release date should be little changed.

Why?
Well, because, fortunately, we decided to spend a big closed beta test and allowed players take a look at our game with a fresh independent view. It was a great idea, we've collected a huge feedback and found in it several moments, that should be 100% changed before the game release.
We just need a little more time.
We want to make the release moment perfect.

How long the release delayed?
Not for long, I can't tell the exact day numbers, but, I think it will be near the week.

So what should we (players) do now?
You may actively participate in the closed beta test!


Thank you for attention! 

We are really sorry for the release delay.

But trust us, it is a necessary delay and all will be great soon!
